d:
Shahi masalon ki khushbu, dahi aur kaju ki rich gravy aur galkar taiyar huaa juicy Mutton! ( ) yah Special Mutton Korma apne har bite men lata hai restaurant-style flavour aur desi masalon ka zabardast svada. garma-garam Roti ya Rice ke sath ekdam shandar!
Preparation time 10 minutes
Cooking time 30-40 minutes
Serve 2-4
Ingredients
For Mutton Marination
1 heaped tbsp Degi Red Chilli powder, degi lal mirch paudar
2 tsp Turmeric powder, haldi paudar
